title: stenotis peninsularis
intro: Stenotis peninsularis, commonly known as Carmona microphylla, is a flowering plant species native to the Iberian Peninsula and North Africa. It is valued for its medicinal properties and has been used to treat various health conditions, including fever, inflammation, and digestive issues, due to its health benefits such as antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties. The plant's therapeutic actions include reducing pain, fighting infections, and promoting wound healing, thanks to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. These bioactive compounds work together to provide a range of health benefits, making Stenotis peninsularis a valuable plant for traditional medicine and natural remedies.
